verdict.rationale: Team and organization management is a fair question for a SaaS web-data API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions sharing scrapers with teammates, organizations, or role-based permissions for users. The only related item is restricted API keys scoped to selected operations, which is an adjacent integration-level control, not teammate or organization RBAC.

support.subject: As a developer, I can share scrapers with teammates and manage organizations and role-based permissions
